Cheng An drank too much, but he was not completely drunk. He kissed Qin Shujian's lips bit by bit. Seeing that she didn't dodge, he slowly hugged her tightly. She didn't refuse, she should have understood his intention. The moment he broke into her world, he held her finger tightly, put it against her ear, and said softly, "I like you." I like you, and have liked you for a long, long time. Maybe it’s from the first sight, maybe it’s the first time I hear your name, maybe it’s the slow flow of water, and the love grows over time. Maybe it was destined,... As soon as they met, they were in love with each other for thousands of years. ...The next morning, when Qin Shujian woke up, Cheng An was still asleep. She stared blankly at the unfamiliar ceiling for a long time before slowly remembering what happened last night. No matter how stupid or stupid she is, she still knows what this night represents. Ever since she entered high school, she had been inexplicably targeted by him, and was ordered by him to either copy his homework, run errands to buy drinks for him, or carry his school bag. When he was sick, he had to ask her to feed him bite by bite. The worst thing was that he would punish her to write love letters when he was unhappy... She was exploited by him for three years. So much so that at first there were always people secretly saying that Cheng An was attracted to her, but in the end she was exploited by him, and everyone jokingly called her Cheng An's "personal maid". And now, she is forced to become a "little maid who sleeps with her"? Qin Shujian shivered, and it felt so scary just thinking about it. Even if... yesterday in the cinema, he told others that he was her man, but that was just to save her. He never said he liked her. She's not really ignorant. She has a low IQ and is even a little stupid, but she understands that she doesn't want to stay with him like this. An idea suddenly took shape in her mind. Qin Shujian took a deep breath. She had never thought about so many problems before, and thinking about so many messy things all at once gave her a headache. She put on her clothes quietly while Cheng An didn't wake up, and went to the bathroom to clean herself up gently. When she came out of the bathroom, she saw that Cheng An was still awake. She breathed a sigh of relief, turned around, and walked cautiously towards the bedroom door. As a result, after taking only two steps, an arm blocked her waist from behind. Cheng An bent over, his chin pressed on her shoulder, and the tip of his nose gently rubbed her neck. He must have just woken up, and his voice was a bit lazy, "Where are you going? Huh?" Qin Shujian subconsciously tensed up. Where to go? ? Of course, run! But she bit her lip and didn't dare to say anything. Cheng An didn't wait for her answer, chuckled, then turned her body around, hugged her waist, and put her on his shoulders with a little force. Qin Shujian was startled when her body suddenly became airborne, and her voice trembled: "You, you, you... what are you doing?" Cheng An threw her back on the bed and stuffed her into the quilt. Qin Shujian looked at the young man who was slowly approaching her in horror. His tired eyes were half-closed, messy hair stuck in the corners of his eyes, and there was a trace of red at the end of his eyes, whether it was because he had not slept well or something, like a seductive fairy. Her breathing gradually became rapid. If someone asked her at this time what it was like for a vixen to seek her life, she would definitely say without hesitation that Cheng An was like this. She felt the area around her sink, and she closed her eyes nervously. Cheng An lifted her into his arms, hugged her waist from behind, put his chin on her neck and rubbed her, "You little fool, sleep a little longer."
